_meta.name: billing
_meta.note: Billing retains only org/project scope, canonical lineage, unit kinds, integer quantities, timestamps, and source event ids. Event payload content, messages, prompts, values, model names, and arbitrary metadata never enter the billing projection.
_meta.reserved_note: Storage is present in the control-plane usage taxonomy, but no canonical spine event currently states a billable storage action. Add the vocabulary event first, then promote the mapping out of this list.
